title: artifact_emit meta: pr-review
description: meta for artifact type 'pr-review'. path: project-relative JSON file with the PR thread data: {pr, threads[], generalComments[], reviews[]} (threads annotated addressed:true/false).

panel_id.description: Stable panel id; re-emitting with the same panel_id updates the panel in place and `close` with it removes it. Defaults to a hash of (type, path).
